# the picker offers the meta models under a no key mark, says the contributor tier trains on what you send, and asks for the key in a dialog of its own that checks it, says a refusal, and never shows it

key enter
wait Select model

wait Meta · no key
wait Meta may train
screen

wait checking with Meta

screen

absent Meta key
